title: Binary gluing of a finitely presented module and a compatible map
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], W and V open subsets, and H a module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] such that H restricted to W is finitely presented [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Let E be a finitely presented module on V, with a map j from E to H restricted to V whose restriction to W intersect V is an isomorphism. There is a finitely presented module G on W union V and a map phi from G to H restricted to W union V whose restriction to W is an isomorphism. No compactness, affineness, quasi-separatedness, or quasi-coherence is assumed, and no module outside W union V is constructed.

proof.text: Use the concrete pullback binarySubmodule with Q = E and iota = j. Its first projection binarySubmoduleInclusion is a map from the pullback module G to H restricted to W union V. No arbitrary existence witness is used.

Apply binarySubmodule_restrictions: the overlap isomorphism hypothesis gives an isomorphism for the first projection on W, and an isomorphism from the restriction of G on V to E. This lemma has no monomorphism or finiteness hypotheses. Compose the isomorphism on W with overFunctorMap to identify G restricted to W with H restricted to W.

Transport finite presentation through the two local isomorphisms using the isFinitePresentation object property. The proved private helper finitePresentation_binary_local identifies overMap restriction with iterated over restriction using Over.iteratedSliceEquiv, whose topology is transported by the defining membership formula for the slice topology. Finite presentation is preserved by the resulting equivalence by the proved source-library lemma isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint. The ULift Bool family of the two opens covers the union: for each point of an open T contained in the union, choose T intersect W or T intersect V according to its membership. Apply the proved source-library lemma IsFinitePresentation.of_coversTop to this family, yielding finite presentation of G. Return G, its first projection, and the already proved isomorphism on W.

proof_origin.note: Concrete pullback route for the gluing paragraph of Stacks 01PI; reuses the proved binary restriction lemma and the proved source-library finite-presentation locality and equivalence transport lemmas. The source was read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PI and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00AK.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finitePresentation_binary_gluing (X : Scheme.{u}) (W V : X.Opens) (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [(H.over W).IsFinitePresentation] (E : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V)) [E.IsFinitePresentation] (j : E ⟶ H.over V) [IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE (show W ⊓ V ≤ V from inf_le_right))).map j)] : ∃ G : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over (W ⊔ V)), G.IsFinitePresentation ∧ ∃ (φ : G ⟶ H.over (W ⊔ V)), IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE (show W ≤ W ⊔ V from le_sup_left))).map φ)
